compressionParam.description:
Compression parameter for scale function. In general, the higher this value is,
the more accurate the estimate will be, and the more clusters will be present after a merge

bufferSize.description: Capacity of buffer. Once full, the buffer will merge with the clusters.

flush.description:
If true, will merge all values initially added regardless of buffer size.
If false, will only merge values that fill up the buffer.
